faq.q: What is the origin of Sohail?
faq.a: Sohail is associated with Arabic. Sohail is Arabic سُهَيْل (Suhayl), the name of the star Canopus.
Yes — the underlying form سُهَيْل is Arabic.
Sohail can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
